definitions.explanation: The seven bright stars of Ursa Major that form a ladle shape, widely used as a guide for finding the North Star.

examples.japanese: {北斗|ほくと}{七星|しちせい}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: I can see the Big Dipper.

examples.japanese: {北斗|ほくと}{七星|しちせい}を{使|つか}って{北極星|ほっきょくせい}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I used the Big Dipper to find the North Star.

examples.japanese: {空気|くうき}が{澄|す}んだ{冬|ふゆ}の{夜|よる}は、{北斗|ほくと}{七星|しちせい}がはっきり{見|み}える。
examples.english: On a clear winter night, the Big Dipper is clearly visible.

notes:
Composed of {北斗|ほくと} (the Northern Dipper) + {七星|しちせい} (seven stars). The seven stars form the well-known ladle shape within the constellation {大熊座|おおぐまざ} (Ursa Major).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北斗|ほくと}{七星|しちせい}を{見|み}つける: to spot the Big Dipper
- {北斗|ほくと}{七星|しちせい}の{形|かたち}: the shape of the Big Dipper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {北極星|ほっきょくせい}: the North Star — found by following the Dipper's two end stars
- {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}: the Southern Cross — its southern-sky counterpart
